rows.33:e120:
Unable to bear the pain, she screamed.
And in front of her family, who came running in alarm, something unbelievable happened.
Her body began to ripple and undulate.
As if everything under her skin had turned to liquid.
...No, it really had turned to liquid.
The tentacles burst out through her skin with tremendous force, and a cloudy white fluid came flowing from their tips.
rows.33:e5ac:
She jumped and spun around, and there stood Date.
"So this is where you were."
That's what he said.
Yaguchi made a show of being a little angry.
"What do you mean, 'so this is where you were'?
You called me from here, didn't you, Date?
That's why I..."
"I never called you."
Date shook his head.
"What? But..."
"You said you'd call me, so I was waiting.
But then I got this bad feeling... so I came looking for you."
Yaguchi couldn't say a word.{p}
rows.33:e890:
"Damn you for getting in my way... A little more and she would have been mine."
The voice came from the phone.
Even though no one had picked up the receiver yet.
"What's this?"
Date said, reaching out his hand.{p}
rows.33:ea40:
......And the next day, the two of them were found.
Date, strangled with the phone cord, and Yaguchi lying collapsed beside him.
The small-minded adults decided it was a breakup that had turned ugly.
They wouldn't even listen to what Yaguchi had to say.
Honestly, adults are so thickheaded.
It's adults like that who deserve to be killed by ghosts.
Don't you think so?{p}
rows.33:ef64:
As Yaguchi tried to scream, the receiver swallowed her with a slurp.
Yes, there's no other word for it but 'swallowed.'
Half of Yaguchi's body was sticking out of a receiver no bigger than a fist.
It was like some absurd surrealist joke.
And then the receiver slowly gulped down the rest of her.{p}
rows.33:f41c:
"Right behind you..."
Yaguchi tried to turn around.
But she couldn't.
It was as though the muscles in her neck had locked up.
And then, at last, a breath really did blow on her from behind.
rows.33:10db4:
I'm so happy.
I'll call you first thing tonight.{p}
